title: Decisions to Build Bukit Panjang LRT System
what_it_is: Decisions to Build Bukit Panjang LRT System

sections.label: Bukit Panjang LRT faults overhaul
sections.summary: Bukit Panjang was picked in 1994 for the LRT pilot though built without LRT in mind, and a tender will be called to overhaul the LRT.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Transport (Mr Ng Chee Meng) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: Bukit Panjang was identified in 1994 for the pilot, even though it was planned and built without LRT in mind.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Transport (Mr Ng Chee Meng) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: To accommodate the existing developments, the LRT had to take sharp turns over undulating terrain.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Transport (Mr Ng Chee Meng) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: Over time, we discovered that this made the LRT prone to faults, especially power trips at the sharp bends, where the trains' collector shoes often dislodge from the power rail.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Transport (Mr Ng Chee Meng) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: LTA and Singapore Mass Rapid Transit (SMRT) have put in significant efforts to improve system reliability, including detailed power rail checks, hotspot replacement and installation of an additional power source.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Transport (Mr Ng Chee Meng) (for the Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: As the LRT is coming to the end of its design life, we will be calling a tender at the end of this year to overhaul the LRT.

sections.label: Keppel tender and LRT design
sections.summary: The LRT was awarded to Keppel Integrated Engineering, the lowest bidder at about $35 million per kilometre, and its straight-line design was adapted to undulating terrain.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: The second question I have is with regard to tender selection when the Line was awarded to Keppel Integrated Engineering (KIE).

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: It was reported that KIE was the lowest bidder and its price worked out to about $35 million per kilometre.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng
sentences.text: As I have stated in my reply, this straight-line design of the LRT was adapted to undulating terrain and sharp turns, and this caused the power collector shoes to dislodge from the power rail.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng
sentences.text: We have taken a look at the design considerations and this will be addressed in the upcoming tender to improve the reliability of the whole system.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng
sentences.text: So, in the initial implementation of the LRT, we adapted a system that is usually for straight-line travel into a housing estate.
